verdict.rationale: v0 is fundamentally a natural-language-to-code/UI agent: users type prompts like 'Build me a personal website' and it generates, plans tasks, fixes errors, and deploys — all via chat commands (v0-gh-1, v0-docs-35, v0-docs-9, v0-docs-5). Community evidence confirms real-world success building a full app via prompting with fast dev-to-deploy cycle, though some note design homogeneity and cost as caveats.
